scope: Independent CPU recomputation from both frozen compiled benchmark raw logs
checks: Every series contains 31 finite, positive timing samples.
Medians and nearest-rank p90 values were recomputed at sorted indices 15 and 27 and agree within the printed precision.
All six host median ratios agree within the printed precision.
All six programs start with zero traces and finish with exactly one trace.
Both logs finish with all three cases and both paths validated.
All 89 source hashes and the compiled binary remain unchanged across both runs.
The measurements do not establish GPU execution times or the contribution of any particular fusion.
